inventory.visualPurpose: Urea cycle map across mitochondria and cytosol
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The p. 80 wheel: ornithine + carbamoyl phosphate (CPS I, mitochondrial, NAG-activated, rate-limiting, 2 ATP) → citrulline (OTC) → cytosol → argininosuccinate (ASS, ATP→AMP+PPi) → arginine (ASL, fumarate out) → urea + ornithine (arginase); OTC block → orotic acid.

inventory.visualPurpose: Alanine transport of ammonia from muscle to liver
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The p. 80 muscle–blood–liver diagram: pyruvate + NH3 → alanine (ALT, B6) in muscle; blood alanine → liver → pyruvate + NH3 → urea cycle; glucose returns (Cahill cycle) beside the Cori cycle's lactate.
